tables.description: Double-entry analysis tables. One table per paradigm dimension.

rows.description: Rows mapping each property to evidence per document/incident.

documents.description: Map of document name → evidence text from that document supporting this property.

simplified_memo.description: 150-250 word condensed version of the descriptive memo. Eliminate redundancy while preserving essence, variation, and core insights. Write in conceptual present tense.

core_statements.description: 3-5 affirmative statements of what the data consistently shows, each backed by specific evidence.

items.description: A single core statement: 'Statement — what the data shows, with evidence reference.'

tensions_flagged.description: Contradictions or paradoxes between findings that suggest an uncaptured dimension.

items.description: A tension: 'Tension between finding X and finding Y — possible paradox or uncaptured dimension.'

simplifier_note.description: Methodological transparency: what was removed, condensed, or restructured and why.
